description.zh: 八字排盘计算：本命盘（bazi_chart）、详细盘（bazi_fullchart）。起名用神取字依据八字用神。
description.en: BaZi chart casting: natal chart (bazi_chart), full chart (bazi_fullchart). Naming yongshen derives from BaZi.

description.zh: 起名规则分析：姓氏（qiming_surname）、取字（qiming_pick）、组名（qiming_compose）、评估（qiming_check）。
description.en: Naming rule-based analysis: surname, pick, compose, check.
